title: Microsoft Teams: express face enrollment from meeting video for Teams Rooms recognition
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements and related enrollment and room-recognition controls are supported. It distinguishes the planned feature from existing enrollment documentation and appropriately leaves the express-face setting and default unresolved.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans face-profile creation using the user's camera during eligible Teams meetings.
claims.quote: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: The arrival default of the planned express-face setting is unknown, separately from user consent and existing enrollment defaults.
claims.quote: Searched: express face enrollment admin setting default eligible meetings prompt; express face enrollment default policy. Read roadmap, enrollment overview and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy: opt-in is stated, but no arrival default for a dedicated express-face setting is specified.

claims.claim: No checked source states that this roadmap item changes existing behavior on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: express face enrollment admin setting default eligible meetings prompt; express face enrollment default policy. Read roadmap, enrollment overview and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy; none describes an automatic replacement or change to existing behavior for this item.

claims.claim: The existing EnrollVoice setting is enabled by default.
claims.quote: The new policy includes three distinct settings which are enabled by default: ... EnrollVoice

claims.claim: The existing EnrollFace setting is enabled by default.
claims.quote: -EnrollFace ... Default value: Enabled

claims.claim: PassiveVoiceEnrollment is normally enabled by default, subject to the stated launch-time duplication qualification.
claims.quote: This setting is typically enabled by default; however any organization that previously had EnrollVoice set to disabled will see a one-time manual state duplication

claims.claim: At express-voice launch, organisations that previously disabled EnrollVoice receive a matching PassiveVoiceEnrollment state once.
claims.quote: any organization that previously had EnrollVoice set to disabled will see a one-time manual state duplication so that both EnrollVoice and PassiveVoiceEnrollment will have the same state when launching this new functionality.

claims.claim: Microsoft retains enrolled users' profiles, distinct from the express-enrollment call media, under its stated retention policies.
claims.quote: When a user is enrolled in the feature and has an active Teams account, Microsoft, on behalf of the user's organization, retains their voice and face profiles in accordance with the following retention policies.

claims.claim: An unused voice or face profile is removed automatically after one year.
claims.quote: a voice and face profile that isn't used for one year is removed automatically.

claims.claim: A profile is removed within 90 days after the organisation deletes the user's Teams account.
claims.quote: If the organization deletes the user's Teams account, the user's voice and face profile is removed within 90 days of the Teams account being deleted.

claims.quote: Face Recognition | Off | Users with enrolled face profile are identified with their face when using this device. Others are distinguished as meeting participants.

claims.claim: Teams Rooms on Windows supports face recognition.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms on Windows | ✅ Supported | ✅ Supported | Device settings or meeting policy

claims.claim: Face recognition requires a supported camera or a Teams Rooms on Windows device with Cloud IntelliFrame enabled.
claims.quote: Face recognition requires a supported camera or Teams Rooms on Windows devices with Cloud IntelliFrame enabled.

claims.quote: Searched: express face enrollment license price metering cost Teams; express face license price. Opened Manage Teams licenses, Microsoft Teams add-on licenses and the enrollment overview; no express-face-specific licence requirement was found.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a price specific to express face enrollment.
claims.quote: Searched: express face enrollment license price metering cost Teams; express face license price. Opened Manage Teams licenses, Microsoft Teams add-on licenses and the enrollment overview; no express-face-specific price was found.

claims.claim: At the time of writing in November 2026, Learn documents no meter for express face enrollment.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams express face enrollment metered billing meter; express face enrollment license price metering cost Teams. Opened enrollment overview, Manage Teams licenses and Microsoft Teams add-on licenses; no applicable enrollment meter was found.

claims.where: licensing.notes; controls[2].note; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: People Recognition in Teams Rooms requires a Teams Rooms Pro licence, separately from express enrollment.
claims.quote: This feature is exclusive to Microsoft Teams Rooms devices with a Teams Rooms Pro license.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included under the existing Teams product licence, with feature-specific licensing left explicitly unpublished.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.

claims.claim: The enrollment overview addresses Enterprise administrators as the audience managing enrollment settings.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can manage voice and face enrollment by using the CsTeamsAIPolicy.

claims.claim: Face enrollment has no language requirement.
claims.quote: There's no language requirement for face enrollment.

claims.claim: The enrollment overview does not name the administrative role required to edit a Teams AI policy.
claims.quote: Searched: voice and face enrollment role Teams AI policy. Read the enrollment overview and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy in full; the overview says Enterprise administrators, without naming a required directory role. This is a claim about that page, not all role documentation.

claims.claim: No admin UI for configuring the EnrollFace Teams AI policy setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams EnrollFace admin center UI PassiveFaceEnrollment PowerShell express face enrollment policy; EnrollFace Teams admin center. Opened enrollment overview: CsTeamsAIPolicy is accessible only through PowerShell; admin-center profile management is a separate capability.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollFace Disabled disables the global policy's active face-enrollment setting.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollFace Disabled ... Set Teams AI policy "EnrollFace" value to "Disabled" for global as default.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documentation does not confirm that EnrollFace controls this new express-face enrollment flow.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams EnrollFace admin center UI PassiveFaceEnrollment PowerShell express face enrollment policy; express face enrollment default policy. Opened enrollment overview and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy: EnrollFace is described as manual/active; express control is specified only for voice.

claims.claim: Teams AI enrollment policy settings can be applied to specific users or groups.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can turn on or off use of voice and face recognition and voice and face enrollment for specific users or groups using the Teams AI Policy.

claims.where: controls[1].ui and controls[1].api; summary; Risk assessment; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No dedicated organisation-wide express-face switch is documented on either the admin UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: express face enrollment admin setting default eligible meetings prompt; Teams EnrollFace admin center UI PassiveFaceEnrollment PowerShell express face enrollment policy. Opened enrollment overview and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy; no dedicated express-face control was found.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented portal route to device-based room recognition configuration is Teams Pro Management Portal > Rooms > Settings > Recognition > Configure with device settings.
claims.quote: Log in to the Teams Pro Management Portal. ... Select Rooms. ... Select Settings followed by the Recognition tab ... Enable Configure with device settings ... Modify to the desired configuration

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <PolicyName> -roomPeopleNameUserOverride Off is the meeting-policy control disabling video-based room identification.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity PolicyName -roomAttributeUserOverride Attribute -roomPeopleNameUserOverride On ... roomPeopleNameUserOverride ... Off - The room won't send video for identification.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Meeting-policy-based room recognition configuration is to be retired in the future.
claims.quote: meeting policy-based configuration will be retired in the future.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends device-level settings for room recognition.
claims.quote: We recommend using device-level settings because meeting policy-based configuration will be retired in the future.

claims.claim: Get-CsTeamsAIPolicy retrieves the tenant's Teams AI policies for inspection.
claims.quote: This cmdlet retrieves all Teams AI policies for the tenant. ... Get-CsTeamsAIPolicy ... Retrieves Teams AI policies and shows "EnrollFace", "EnrollVoice" and "SpeakerAttributionBYOD" values.

claims.claim: PassiveVoiceEnrollment governs express voice enrollment rather than being documented as an express-face parameter.
claims.quote: PassiveVoiceEnrollment controls user access to express voice enrollment in the Teams app settings.

claims.claim: The Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy reference lists no parameter named for express face enrollment.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams EnrollFace admin center UI PassiveFaceEnrollment PowerShell express face enrollment policy. Read Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy syntax and all parameters: EnrollFace, EnrollVoice, PassiveVoiceEnrollment and SpeakerAttributionBYOD; no express-face-named parameter.

claims.claim: Administrators can view end-user voice and face enrollment status in Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can now use Teams admin center to view end-user voice and face enrollment status and manage enrolled data directly from the admin experience.

claims.claim: Administrators can delete end-user voice and face profiles and enrollment data in Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can also delete end-user voice and face profiles and enrollment data directly from the Teams admin center.

claims.claim: The admin-center enrollment-data management capability does not change default feature availability or enrollment behavior.
claims.quote: This capability does not change default feature availability and enrollment behavior. Existing policies and end-user controls for voice and face recognition and enrollment remain the same.

claims.claim: The enrollment overview names Teams admin center for profile management without providing its menu path.
claims.quote: Searched: voice and face enrollment Teams admin center Users menu; EnrollFace Teams admin center. Read the enrollment overview's Manage enrollment data in Teams admin center and FAQ sections: both name the center, but neither provides navigation steps.

claims.claim: The eligibility criteria for meetings used by this planned express-face feature have not been specified.
claims.quote: Searched: express face eligible; express face enrollment admin setting default eligible meetings prompt. Read roadmap, enrollment overview and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy: the record says eligible meetings, but no definition of meeting eligibility for this item was found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The checked documentation does not specify who receives the new express-face prompt, when it appears or how policy changes affect it.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams express face enrollment prompt; express face enrollment admin setting default eligible meetings prompt. Opened enrollment overview and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy; neither specifies this new prompt's audience, timing or response to policy changes.
